entries.title: A computer that runs work starts again after a forced restart
entries.body: After a power cut or forced restart, a computer that runs work for another Mac could stay stuck and never start. It now starts by itself. If its work still cannot start, Settings → Devices says so instead of showing connecting.
entries.noPicture: The fix is a computer starting again after a restart; Devices shows its existing could-not-start line.
